name: smooth_bands
description: crisp smooth escape bands through a map matched to the reference, by rank at the reference's band order, with a dark hair on de keeping the lace sharp

reference.made_with: an escape-time deep zoom of the Mandelbrot set, unsigned, 2560x1600

reuses: seahorse_halo's stack: the smooth count through the matched map by rank at 2 cycles, the reference's band order
glow_filaments' falloff glow on de, painted near-black and multiplied at half opacity: the dark hair that keeps the lace crisp
the tone pass, at the reference's median and p10
notes: Round one's palette entries from item 045 (values in the catalog's set, unkept until a tile is): krinshinda_smooth (krinshinda.jpg) at 1 cycle, a navy-to-sky-blue far field into a white rim and the lace's gold, orange, lime and red, tone 0.182/0.033; lander_smooth (lander.jpg) at 1 cycle, half the map near-black navy so the Julia chain burns gold and red on a dark ground, tone 0.024/0.003; learned_smooth (learned.jpg) at 6 cycles through a stepped map (each stripe a short ramp with a hard edge, the reference's hard-edged bands), tone 0.606/0.303. The reference's stippled dots along each stripe are not drawn.
council_smooth: Added: nothing: the smooth count through council_smooth by rank at 2 cycles, a dark `de` hair, the tone pass

council_smooth: Fitted: the first map read hot pink and missed p10 at 25 of 28 drafts (0.40-0.44 against 0.30); a dustier rose, a second grey-blue stop and a wider wine-maroon span held all six check drafts.

council_smooth: Lessons: item 031 brought six references Matt liked for their palette and its colour cycling, all close to plain smooth escape time, so each is seahorse_halo's light stack (the smooth count through a cyclic matched map by rank, a dark `de` hair, the tone pass) with its own map and cycle count, no new primitive. The cycle count is read off the reference's band order from the far field to the spiral's heart. The maps were fitted on pool drafts: a map whose dark stops are narrow misses p10 high at every seat (the tone pass pins the median but cannot make a dark the map does not spend), fixed by widening the dark stops, never by darkening the interior. The spiral references (forest, council, crisis, corkscrew) are scouted with `style scout --spiral` (Matt's ruling on item 031: only when the reference itself is a spiral); mandelbrot3 and dalooka with the default draw.
